markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 过去完成时说的是**「过去的过去」**：过去有两件事，**先发生**的那件用 had + 过去分词。口诀：**过去再往前退一步。**

uses.zh: 两件过去的事，先发生的那件
uses.en: <<When>> I got to the station, the train [[had]] <<already>> [[left]].
uses.en_zh: 我到车站时，火车已经开走了。

uses.zh: 过去某个时间之前就已经做完
uses.en_zh: 到上午十点，我们已经修好了这个 bug。

uses.en: I was nervous because I [[hadn't given]] a talk <<before>>.
uses.en_zh: 我很紧张，因为我以前从没做过演讲。

form.title: 怎么构成
form.rule: 所有人都用 had，不分 I、he、they。否定用 hadn't，疑问把 had 放到最前面。

examples.en: We [[hadn't tested]] it on older phones.
examples.zh: 我们之前没在老手机上测过。

contractions: I had = I[['d]] · she had = she[['d]]
notes: I'd 可能是 I had，也可能是 I would。后面直接跟过去分词（gone、done）的，就是 I had；跟动词原形（go、do）的，就是 I would。

timeline.title: 画一条时间线
timeline.text: 先在时间线上找到「过去的那个点」。比那个点**更早**的事用 had + 过去分词，那个点本身用一般过去时。

items.rule: 先：会议开始 → 后：我到了
items.zh: 我到的时候，会议已经开始了。

items.rule: by the time 后面就是「那个点」
items.en: <<By the time>> we [[released]] the update, users [[had reported]] 50 bugs.
items.zh: 等我们发布更新时，用户已经报了 50 个 bug。

items.rule: after 后面是先发生的事
items.en: <<After>> she [[had finished]] the review, she [[went]] for lunch.
items.zh: 她做完代码审查后，去吃了午饭。

notneeded.title: 不用 had 也行
notneeded.text: 如果按顺序一件件讲，或者 before、after 已经把先后说清楚了，用一般过去时就够了，不用 had。

items.en: I [[made]] a coffee, [[checked]] my emails and then [[went]] to work.
items.zh: 我冲了杯咖啡，看了邮件，然后去上班。
她走了以后，我给 Tom 打了电话。

continuous.title: 过去完成进行时
continuous.text: 在过去某个点之前，一件事**已经持续了一段时间**，用 had been + 动词 ing。说的是「当时已经做了多久」。

examples.en: I [[had been waiting]] <<for>> an hour when the bus finally came.
examples.zh: 我已经等了一个小时，公交才终于来了。

examples.en: She was tired because she [[had been working]] all night.
examples.zh: 她很累，因为她整夜都在工作。

examples.en: We [[had been using]] the old API <<for>> years before we switched.
examples.zh: 换掉之前，我们用那个旧 API 已经好几年了。

this.meaning: 我到的时候，会议早就开始了

this.en: I [[had]] <<never>> [[seen]] snow before I moved to Scotland.

that.meaning: 站在现在，看到现在为止

commonMistakes.bad: When I arrived, the train ~~already left~~.
commonMistakes.why: 火车走在我到之前，更早的事用 had + 过去分词。
had 后面用过去分词 gone，不用 went。

commonMistakes.bad: She ~~has~~ already left when I called.
commonMistakes.why: 整件事都在过去，用 had，不用 has。

commonMistakes.bad: Before I joined the team, I had never ~~use~~ Swift.
commonMistakes.good: Before I joined the team, I [[had]] never [[used]] Swift.
commonMistakes.why: had 后面要用过去分词 used。

quiz.prompt: When I got to the station, the train ___. I'd missed it by five minutes.
quiz.explain: 火车先走，我后到，先发生的用 [[had left]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我到的时候，会议已经开始了。
quiz.answer: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
accept: When I arrived, the meeting had started.
The meeting had already started when I arrived.
The meeting had started when I arrived.
When I got there, the meeting had already started.
When I got there, the meeting had started.
By the time I arrived, the meeting had already started.
By the time I arrived, the meeting had started.

quiz.explain: 到某个过去时间点已经做完：[[had fixed]]。

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：They had tested it on older phones.
quiz.answer: They hadn't tested it on older phones.
accept: They had not tested it on older phones.

traps.input: They didn't have tested it on older phones.
traps.note: 过去完成时的否定直接用 hadn't。

quiz.prompt: 改成一般疑问句：She had met him before.
针对划线部分提问：She had already sent the email.（问「什么」）

traps.input: What did she had already sent?
traps.note: 直接用 had 来问，不要再加 did。

quiz.prompt: By the time we released the update, users ___ (report) 50 bugs.
quiz.explain: 报 bug 在发布之前：[[had reported]]。

quiz.prompt: After she ___ the review, she went for lunch.
quiz.explain: 先做完审查，再去吃饭：[[had finished]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：When I arrived, the train already left.
quiz.answer: When I arrived, the train had already left.
accept: When I arrived, the train had left.

quiz.prompt: First I ___ (make) a coffee, then I checked my emails.

traps.note: 按顺序一件件讲，用一般过去时就够了。

quiz.explain: 按顺序讲，用一般过去时：I [[made]]。

quiz.prompt: I ___ (wait) for an hour when the bus finally came.
quiz.explain: 公交来之前已经等了一个小时：[[had been waiting]]。

quiz.prompt: She was exhausted because she ___ all night.
quiz.explain: 累是过去的事，在那之前一直在干活：[[had been working]]。

quiz.prompt: When I arrived, the meeting ___, so I missed the start.
quiz.explain: 我错过了开头，说明会议开始得更早：[[had started]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I had went home before it started to rain.
quiz.answer: I had gone home before it started to rain.
accept: I'd gone home before it started to rain.
quiz.explain: had 后面用过去分词：[[had gone]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：She has already left when I called.
quiz.answer: She had already left when I called.
accept: She'd already left when I called.

openTask.prompt: 用过去完成时说 3 句话，讲一次「我到的时候，事情已经发生了」的经历。至少一句用 by the time 或 when。
rules: 更早发生的事用 had + 过去分词
had 后面用过去分词，不用过去式（had went 是错的）
按顺序讲或 before / after 已经说清先后时，用一般过去时也可以
openTask.note: 规则判 had + 过去分词和先后顺序（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
